lede: Arizona Cardinals carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#18 in EPA per play), while Denver Broncos owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#5 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Arizona Cardinals +2.3 with a fair total of 45.5 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Arizona Cardinals pass offence vs Denver Broncos pass defence, which sits −0.195 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Denver Broncos and Arizona Cardinals have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
